migration.objects: all LLD-03 identity, relationship, source-projection, terminal-cascade, archive-history and protection objects

forward_additions.objects: sr_source_presence_events plus append-only chain guards and supporting indexes

reverse_orphan_checks: Every authoritative LLD-03 command has exactly one bounded traceability edge proving request/response, transaction boundary, revision effects, audit, errors, tests and COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1 or the exact shared outer-command equivalent.
Every LLD-03 query has deterministic total ordering, bounded point semantics or CURSOR_V1 keyset pagination, supporting index evidence and concrete tests.

Accepted Advanced Search disappearance creates one immutable disappearance_reviewed owner event only after exact LLD-04 population-absence validation; GetServiceRequest derives SR_SOURCE_DISAPPEARANCE_REVIEWED only from the current chain head. Automatic reappearance appends one reappearance_confirmed event only after exact published-run identity evidence and never accepts source fields or mutates ticket lifecycle/relationships.

The source-presence repair is a forward LLD-03 addition at globally reserved sequence 14. Historical migration 3 and reserved sequences 6 through 13 remain unchanged; runtime 0014 cannot be accepted or applied until the complete 1 through 13 prefix exists.
Direct SR-to-RFC persistence targets only the governing root; subordinate SR context is query-derived and RFC hierarchy remains exactly two levels.

RFC reparent/detach review freshness is SOMA_RFC_HIERARCHY_REVIEW_V1: exact old/new structural branch authority plus old edge, blockers/warnings and the complete bounded LLD-05 history risk/count/provider fingerprint. Preview uses one stable Snapshot; writer recomputes the same RfcHistoryRiskProvider authority in its current UnitOfWork before receipt/mutation. Any relevant history change stales the review even when hierarchy and LOW/HIGH classification are unchanged; INDETERMINATE never authorizes mutation; no provider-owned Task/WFM/Objective rows are copied into LLD-03.

The RFC hierarchy review-freshness repair changes no persisted schema or migration allocation; it composes existing hierarchy state with bounded read-only LLD-05 authority and leaves historical migration 3 unchanged.

Accepted terminal RFC source evidence may create or supersede a pending cascade proposal but never executes Task/Objective/Communication consequences; ExecuteRfcTerminalCascade separately requires exact proposal/terminal/scope freshness, both complete provider impact revalidations, exact reviewed SOMA_RFC_TERMINAL_CASCADE_PREVIEW_V1 equality and only then a session-bound deliberate proof before same-UoW participant effects.
Device Reference identity and ticket links survive later Infrastructure regularization; Working Notes remain SOMA-owned and import-inaccessible.

LLD-04 source/proposal identities stored by LLD-03 are exact immutable opaque evidence references validated through provider interfaces; neither sequence 3 nor forward sequence 14 creates a physical FK or trigger into LLD-04 private tables.
RFC archive/restore is operation-scoped SOMA-local presentation state; protected history is append-preserved.

RFC hard delete is limited to a determinate untouched manual/purely-local provisional draft: stable read preview and current writer revalidation share the exact local/provider predicates, SOMA_RFC_HARD_DELETE_ELIGIBILITY_V1 has a golden vector, stale/blocked state fails before LLD-12 proof consumption, successful delete persists only bounded audit/result evidence, and exact replay requires no surviving RFC row or reusable proof.
